name: The Geography Compass
tip: Use a compass rose to check directions before describing a route.

questions.q: Which line divides Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
questions.why: The Equator is at 0° latitude and divides the two hemispheres.

questions.q: What does a map scale help you calculate?
questions.why: A scale compares map distance with actual distance.

questions.q: Which direction is opposite to south-east?
questions.why: The opposite direction across the compass is north-west.
